```artifact
Feature: Services Offered in and around Padmavathi Hospital

  Scenario: Services offered within a radius of 25 sqkm or specified PinCodes
    Given the hospital is located at PinCode 123456
    And the radius of service is 25 sqkm
    When a patient registers with PinCode 123456
    Then the services are offered to the patient

  Scenario: Services offered to patients residing in the Zone
    Given the hospital is located at PinCode 123456
    And the patient is residing at PinCode 123456
    When the patient registers for an appointment
    Then the appointment is scheduled

  Scenario: Authorized Chemist per PinCode
    Given the hospital is located at PinCode 123456
    And there is one authorized chemist per PinCode
    When a patient requests a prescription
    Then the prescription is routed to the authorized chemist

  Scenario: Prescription routed to Chemist based on PinCode
    Given the hospital is located at PinCode 123456
    And the patient has PinCode 123456
    And the chemist has PinCode 123456
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the prescription is routed to the chemist

  Scenario: Offline delivery and payment collection by Chemist
    Given the hospital is located at PinCode 123456
    And the chemist is authorized to deliver medicines
    When the chemist delivers the medicines
    Then the payment is collected from the patient

  Scenario: Prescription marked as completed by Chemist
    Given the hospital is located at PinCode 123456
    And the chemist has delivered the medicines
    When the chemist marks the prescription as completed
    Then the prescription is marked as completed

  Scenario: No systemic matching of Chemist efficiency
    Given the hospital is located at PinCode 123456
    And there is no systemic matching of chemist efficiency
    When a patient requests a prescription
    Then the prescription is routed to the authorized chemist

  Scenario: Authorized Laboratory per PinCode or Zone
    Given the hospital is located at PinCode 123456
    And there is one authorized laboratory per PinCode
    When a patient requests a test
    Then the test is conducted by the authorized laboratory
```
